name: azure
description: Work across Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps through the Azure CLI without imposing a project workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Azure CLI and Azure DevOps access
interface.longDescription: Use the Azure CLI as the general interaction surface for Microsoft Azure resources and Azure DevOps. Discover the live subscription, tenant, organization, project, and repository before acting; keep commands explicitly scoped; and follow the user's request and each repository's own workflow instead of imposing a merge, testing, review, or release lifecycle.
defaultPrompt: Show me which Azure subscriptions and resources I can access
Inspect this Azure DevOps repository or pull request
Help me make this Azure change
